paper_title: Helioscope Bounds on Hidden Sector Photons
notes: Solar/stellar bound (NOT a DM haloscope), so no local DM density. Constrains kinetic mixing chi of hidden (dark) photon vs mass mγ' from solar energy-loss (lifetime) argument and CAST helioscope non-observation. Main result in Fig. 6 (plot, no numerical table). Low-mass lifetime bound points computed from Wγ'=8e43 χ²(mγ'/eV)⁴ W set to L_sun=3.83e26 W (chi=2.19e-9*(m/eV)^-2 for m<1 eV); resonant region (1-295 eV) reaches chi~1e-14 at solar core; higher-mass points are rough envelope reads. Best limits quoted over 3 meV < mγ' < 40 keV, chi down to ~1e-14.
